tracked_patterns.name: Liquidity Sweep

tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: None for the sweep itself; awaiting follow-through confirmation above recent highs.

tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Confirmation breakdown below the neckline around 61000-61200.

tracked_patterns.name: Break of Structure (BOS)

tracked_patterns.name: Ascending Triangle
tracked_patterns.evidence: Higher lows forming since the 08:00 swing low with resistance clustering near 61900-62000.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Clear breakout above horizontal resistance at ~62000 with volume confirmation.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Prior bearish structure (lower highs and lower lows from 22:00 to 08:00) was invalidated by a strong rally above the 61500 swing high after the 08:00 low near 60500.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Sustained close above the prior swing high and formation of a higher low to confirm a bullish Break of Structure (BOS).

tracked_patterns.name: Symmetrical Triangle
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price forming lower highs since 62000 peak and higher lows since ~60800, creating converging trendlines near current price 61500.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Breakout above 62000 or breakdown below 60800 required for confirmation.

tracked_patterns.name: Head and Shoulders
tracked_patterns.evidence: Left shoulder near 61500, head at 62000, right shoulder forming near 61500 with neckline support around 60800-61000.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Decisive close below neckline (~60800-61000) to confirm reversal.

tracked_patterns.name: Order Block
tracked_patterns.evidence: Bullish order block formed at the base of the strong upward move around 60600-60800, from which price rallied sharply.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Price retest of the block zone for confirmation of support.
